newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel industrial output unchanged in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Israel industrial output unchanged in Jan-Feb.

text.p: Israel's industrial production remained unchanged in January and February in comparison to the fourth quarter of 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics announced on Sunday.
Since the beginning of 1996 the rate of growth in industrial output has been steadily declining, the government bureau said.
In the first quarter of 1996 industrial production rose by a monthly average of 0.5 percent, in the second quarter by 0.3 percent and in the third quarter by 0.1 percent.
In the fourth quarter there was no change in industrial output.
Israel's economy is slowing down and many private sector economists predict there will be zero growth in per capita gross domestic product in 1997.
